entries.exampleNative: Desempeña un papel clave en el proyecto.
entries.exampleEnglish: She plays a key role in the project.

entries.exampleNative: Yo gestiono las cuentas del equipo.
entries.exampleEnglish: I manage the team's accounts.

entries.exampleNative: El negocio empieza a ser rentable.
entries.exampleEnglish: The business is starting to be profitable.

entries.exampleNative: Metemos parte del ahorro en un depósito.
entries.exampleEnglish: We put part of our savings in a deposit account.

entries.exampleNative: Nos queda hipoteca para quince años.
entries.exampleEnglish: We have fifteen years left on the mortgage.

entries.exampleNative: Pedimos un préstamo para reformar la cocina.
entries.exampleEnglish: We took out a loan to renovate the kitchen.

entries.exampleNative: La cuota mensual del gimnasio son treinta euros.
entries.exampleEnglish: The monthly gym fee is thirty euros.

entries.exampleNative: No quiero endeudarme por un coche.
entries.exampleEnglish: I don't want to get into debt over a car.

entries.exampleNative: Con ese sueldo cuesta llegar a fin de mes.
entries.exampleEnglish: On that salary it's hard to make ends meet.

entries.exampleNative: Hubo una subida de precios en enero.
entries.exampleEnglish: There was a price rise in January.

entries.exampleNative: Dejó el banco para emprender por su cuenta.
entries.exampleEnglish: He left the bank to start his own business.

entries.exampleNative: Ahora trabaja por su cuenta desde casa.
entries.exampleEnglish: Now she works freelance from home.

entries.exampleNative: Tengo un agobio tremendo con los exámenes.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm terribly stressed about the exams.

entries.exampleNative: No te agobies, aún queda tiempo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't get overwhelmed, there's still time.

entries.gloss: to get it off one's chest
entries.exampleNative: Necesitaba desahogarme con alguien.
entries.exampleEnglish: I needed to get it off my chest with someone.

entries.exampleNative: Fue un alivio enorme saber que estaba bien.
entries.exampleEnglish: It was a huge relief to know she was fine.

entries.exampleNative: Se llevó una decepción con el resultado.
entries.exampleEnglish: He was disappointed with the result.

entries.exampleNative: No quiero decepcionar a mis padres.
entries.exampleEnglish: I don't want to disappoint my parents.

entries.exampleNative: La desilusión le duró varias semanas.
entries.exampleEnglish: The disillusionment lasted her several weeks.

entries.exampleNative: Quedó cierto resentimiento entre los dos.
entries.exampleEnglish: Some resentment remained between the two of them.

entries.exampleNative: No le guardo ningún rencor.
entries.exampleEnglish: I don't hold any grudge against him.

entries.exampleNative: Me da envidia sana tu tranquilidad.
entries.exampleEnglish: I envy your calm, in a good way.

entries.exampleNative: Habla de su hija con mucho orgullo.
entries.exampleEnglish: He talks about his daughter with great pride.

entries.exampleNative: Me dio vergüenza ajena verlo cantar.
entries.exampleEnglish: Watching him sing made me cringe for him.

entries.exampleNative: Me hace mucha ilusión el viaje.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm really excited about the trip.

entries.exampleNative: Aceptó la propuesta con entusiasmo.
entries.exampleEnglish: She accepted the proposal enthusiastically.

entries.exampleNative: Hoy trabajo con mucha desgana.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm working very reluctantly today.

entries.exampleNative: Lleva unos meses con bastante apatía.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's been rather apathetic for a few months.

entries.exampleNative: Siento nostalgia de mi ciudad.
entries.exampleEnglish: I feel homesick for my city.

entries.exampleNative: Habla con añoranza de aquellos veranos.
entries.exampleEnglish: She speaks with longing about those summers.

entries.exampleNative: Echo mucho de menos a mi hermana.
entries.exampleEnglish: I miss my sister a lot.

entries.exampleNative: Sus palabras fueron un gran consuelo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Her words were a great comfort.

entries.exampleNative: La noticia causó bastante desconcierto.
entries.exampleEnglish: The news caused quite a bit of bewilderment.

entries.exampleNative: Me miró con asombro cuando se lo conté.
entries.exampleEnglish: He looked at me in astonishment when I told him.

entries.exampleNative: Hay mucha desconfianza entre los socios.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a lot of distrust between the partners.

entries.exampleNative: Te lo digo con toda franqueza.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm telling you in all frankness.

entries.exampleNative: Valoro mucho su sinceridad.
entries.exampleEnglish: I really value her sincerity.

entries.exampleNative: Le falta empatía con sus compañeros.
entries.exampleEnglish: He lacks empathy with his colleagues.

entries.exampleNative: Se me está acabando la paciencia.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm running out of patience.

entries.exampleNative: Hay que tener paciencia con los niños.
entries.exampleEnglish: You have to be patient with children.

entries.exampleNative: Mi padre es muy cabezota.
entries.exampleEnglish: My father is very stubborn.

entries.exampleNative: Es terco, no va a cambiar de idea.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's obstinate, he won't change his mind.

entries.exampleNative: No le digas nada, está muy susceptible.
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't say anything to her, she's very touchy.

entries.exampleNative: Se puso muy borde sin motivo.
entries.exampleEnglish: He got really snappy for no reason.

entries.exampleNative: Sus vecinos son muy majos.
entries.exampleEnglish: Her neighbours are really nice.

entries.exampleNative: Fue una despedida muy entrañable.
entries.exampleEnglish: It was a very heartwarming farewell.

entries.gloss: to put up with, to bear
entries.exampleNative: No soporto el ruido de las obras.
entries.exampleEnglish: I can't stand the noise from the building work.

entries.exampleNative: Me llevo muy bien con mis cuñados.
entries.exampleEnglish: I get on very well with my in-laws.

entries.exampleNative: Tu amiga me cae muy bien.
entries.exampleEnglish: I really like your friend.

entries.exampleNative: Me da igual dónde cenemos.
entries.exampleEnglish: I don't mind where we have dinner.

entries.exampleNative: Me hace ilusión verte de nuevo.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm looking forward to seeing you again.

entries.exampleNative: Estoy hasta las narices de esperar.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm fed up with waiting.

entries.exampleNative: Aprendió a sobrellevar la situación.
entries.exampleEnglish: She learned to cope with the situation.

entries.exampleNative: Estoy desbordado de trabajo esta semana.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm overwhelmed with work this week.

entries.exampleNative: El alquiler ha subido cien euros este año.
entries.exampleEnglish: The rent has gone up a hundred euros this year.

entries.exampleNative: El casero tarda mucho en arreglar las cosas.
entries.exampleEnglish: The landlord takes ages to fix things.

entries.exampleNative: Los inquilinos anteriores dejaron el piso impecable.
entries.exampleEnglish: The previous tenants left the flat spotless.

entries.exampleNative: El contrato de alquiler es de cinco años.
entries.exampleEnglish: The lease is for five years.

entries.exampleNative: Los gastos de comunidad no están incluidos.
entries.exampleEnglish: Service charges aren't included.

entries.exampleNative: Los suministros van aparte del alquiler.
entries.exampleEnglish: Utilities are separate from the rent.

entries.exampleNative: El contrato prohíbe subarrendar la habitación.
entries.exampleEnglish: The contract forbids subletting the room.

entries.exampleNative: Buscamos un piso amueblado y exterior.
entries.exampleEnglish: We're looking for a furnished, outward-facing flat.

entries.exampleNative: Es un piso exterior, entra mucha luz.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's an outward-facing flat, lots of light comes in.

entries.exampleNative: La cocina está a estrenar tras la reforma.
entries.exampleEnglish: The kitchen is brand new after the renovation.

entries.exampleNative: Vamos a reformar el baño en primavera.
entries.exampleEnglish: We're going to renovate the bathroom in spring.

entries.exampleNative: El edificio está a estrenar.
entries.exampleEnglish: The building is brand new.

entries.exampleNative: Hubo una avería en la caldera.
entries.exampleEnglish: There was a fault in the boiler.

entries.exampleNative: La caldera hace un ruido raro.
entries.exampleEnglish: The boiler is making a strange noise.

entries.exampleNative: Llamé al fontanero por una fuga.
entries.exampleEnglish: I called the plumber about a leak.

entries.exampleNative: Hay una fuga de agua debajo del fregadero.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a water leak under the sink.

entries.exampleNative: Se ha atascado el desagüe de la ducha.
entries.exampleEnglish: The shower drain has got blocked.

entries.exampleNative: El desagüe huele mal desde ayer.
entries.exampleEnglish: The drain has smelled bad since yesterday.

entries.exampleNative: No hay enchufes junto a la cama.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are no sockets next to the bed.

entries.exampleNative: Se saltó el diferencial del cuadro eléctrico.
entries.exampleEnglish: The trip switch on the fuse box went.

entries.exampleNative: Baja la persiana, entra mucho sol.
entries.exampleEnglish: Lower the blind, too much sun is coming in.

entries.exampleNative: Voy a tender la ropa en el balcón.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going to hang the washing on the balcony.

entries.exampleNative: Hoy me toca hacer la colada.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's my turn to do the laundry today.

entries.exampleNative: Después de cenar friego los platos.
entries.exampleEnglish: After dinner I wash the dishes.

entries.exampleNative: Barre la cocina antes de fregar.
entries.exampleEnglish: Sweep the kitchen before mopping.

entries.exampleNative: Tengo que ordenar el armario este finde.
entries.exampleEnglish: I have to tidy the wardrobe this weekend.

entries.exampleNative: Mi cuarto está muy desordenado.
entries.exampleEnglish: My room is very messy.

entries.exampleNative: Guardamos las maletas en el trastero.
entries.exampleEnglish: We keep the suitcases in the storage room.

entries.exampleNative: El trastero está lleno de cacharros viejos.
entries.exampleEnglish: The storage room is full of old junk.

entries.exampleNative: La mudanza nos llevó todo el sábado.
entries.exampleEnglish: The move took us all Saturday.

entries.exampleNative: Nos mudamos a las afueras el mes que viene.
entries.exampleEnglish: We're moving to the outskirts next month.

entries.exampleNative: Vivir en las afueras sale más barato.
entries.exampleEnglish: Living on the outskirts works out cheaper.

entries.exampleNative: Es un vecindario muy tranquilo.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's a very quiet neighbourhood.

entries.exampleNative: Te espero en el portal a las ocho.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'll wait for you in the entrance at eight.

entries.exampleNative: La comunidad de vecinos se reúne el martes.
entries.exampleEnglish: The residents' association meets on Tuesday.

entries.exampleNative: Hay obras en el portal desde enero.
entries.exampleEnglish: There have been works in the entrance since January.

entries.exampleNative: El piso tiene mal aislamiento térmico.
entries.exampleEnglish: The flat has poor thermal insulation.

entries.exampleNative: Hay una mancha de humedad en el techo.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a damp patch on the ceiling.

entries.exampleNative: Mi rutina cambia mucho en verano.
entries.exampleEnglish: My routine changes a lot in summer.

entries.exampleNative: Hoy te toca sacar la basura.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's your turn to take out the rubbish today.

entries.exampleNative: Aquí reciclamos el vidrio y el cartón.
entries.exampleEnglish: Here we recycle glass and cardboard.

entries.exampleNative: Nos apañamos bien con una sola habitación.
entries.exampleEnglish: We manage fine with just one bedroom.

entries.exampleNative: Mi cuñado nos ayudó con la mudanza.
entries.exampleEnglish: My brother-in-law helped us with the move.

entries.exampleNative: Comemos en casa de mi suegra los domingos.
entries.exampleEnglish: We eat at my mother-in-law's on Sundays.

entries.exampleNative: Su yerno trabaja en el mismo barrio.
entries.exampleEnglish: Her son-in-law works in the same neighbourhood.

entries.exampleNative: Su nuera es de Valencia.
entries.exampleEnglish: His daughter-in-law is from Valencia.

entries.exampleNative: No tenemos ningún parentesco, solo el apellido.
entries.exampleEnglish: We're not related at all, just share the surname.

entries.exampleNative: Sus antepasados vinieron de Galicia.
entries.exampleEnglish: Her ancestors came from Galicia.

entries.exampleNative: Me llevo genial con mi hermanastro.
entries.exampleEnglish: I get on great with my stepbrother.

entries.exampleNative: Mi padrastro me enseñó a conducir.
entries.exampleEnglish: My stepfather taught me to drive.

entries.exampleNative: La familia de acogida vive cerca.
entries.exampleEnglish: The foster family lives nearby.

entries.exampleNative: La abuela tiene la tutela de los niños.
entries.exampleEnglish: The grandmother has guardianship of the children.

entries.exampleNative: Acordaron la custodia compartida.
entries.exampleEnglish: They agreed on shared custody.

entries.exampleNative: Cumple la mayoría de edad en mayo.
entries.exampleEnglish: He reaches legal adulthood in May.

entries.exampleNative: Criaron a tres hijos ellos solos.
entries.exampleEnglish: They raised three children on their own.

entries.exampleNative: Tienen ideas distintas sobre la crianza.
entries.exampleEnglish: They have different ideas about parenting.

entries.exampleNative: Es un chico muy educado.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a very well-mannered boy.

entries.exampleNative: No quiero que salga malcriado.
entries.exampleEnglish: I don't want him to turn out spoilt.

entries.exampleNative: De pequeña era muy traviesa.
entries.exampleEnglish: She was very mischievous as a little girl.

entries.exampleNative: Su madre lo regañó por llegar tarde.
entries.exampleEnglish: His mother told him off for arriving late.

entries.exampleNative: Los abuelos consienten mucho a los nietos.
entries.exampleEnglish: Grandparents indulge their grandchildren a lot.

entries.exampleNative: Se parece muchísimo a su padre.
entries.exampleEnglish: She looks a lot like her father.

entries.exampleNative: Ha salido a su abuela en el carácter.
entries.exampleEnglish: She takes after her grandmother in temperament.

entries.exampleNative: La convivencia con compañeros de piso no es fácil.
entries.exampleEnglish: Living with flatmates isn't easy.

entries.exampleNative: Busco compañero de piso para septiembre.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm looking for a flatmate for September.

entries.exampleNative: Vive con su pareja desde hace dos años.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's been living with her partner for two years.

entries.exampleNative: Me presentó a su prometido en la boda.
entries.exampleEnglish: She introduced me to her fiancé at the wedding.

entries.exampleNative: Tras un noviazgo largo, se casaron.
entries.exampleEnglish: After a long relationship, they got married.

entries.exampleNative: Se separaron de forma amistosa.
entries.exampleEnglish: They separated amicably.

entries.exampleNative: Nos distanciamos después de la discusión.
entries.exampleEnglish: We grew apart after the argument.

entries.exampleNative: Al final se reconciliaron.
entries.exampleEnglish: In the end they made up.

entries.exampleNative: Tuvimos una discusión tonta por dinero.
entries.exampleEnglish: We had a silly argument about money.

entries.exampleNative: Siempre he tenido el apoyo de mi familia.
entries.exampleEnglish: I've always had my family's support.

entries.exampleNative: Contrataron un cuidador para el abuelo.
entries.exampleEnglish: They hired a carer for their grandfather.

entries.exampleNative: Está a cargo de sus dos hermanos pequeños.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's responsible for her two younger brothers.

entries.exampleNative: Se independizó a los veinticinco.
entries.exampleEnglish: He moved out on his own at twenty-five.

entries.exampleNative: Es la tercera generación en el negocio familiar.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's the third generation in the family business.

entries.exampleNative: Repartieron la herencia sin discutir.
entries.exampleEnglish: They divided the inheritance without arguing.

entries.exampleNative: Hacemos una reunión familiar cada Navidad.
entries.exampleEnglish: We have a family gathering every Christmas.

entries.exampleNative: Solo asistieron familiares y allegados.
entries.exampleEnglish: Only family and close friends attended.

entries.exampleNative: No es amigo mío, es solo un conocido.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's not a friend of mine, just an acquaintance.

entries.exampleNative: Nuestra amistad viene del colegio.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our friendship goes back to school.

entries.gloss: to meet up, arrange to meet
entries.exampleNative: Quedamos el sábado para tomar algo.
entries.exampleEnglish: We're meeting up on Saturday for a drink.
